goal: LEXICON: KEEP THE CHAINS MOVING = 3rd-and-short continuous forward progress
body:
Dave adds another executable NouGen phrase: KEEP THE CHAINS MOVING.

Football semantics: treat the work like 3rd-and-short. Not every possession needs a touchdown immediately. Gain the next necessary yard, preserve possession, establish the new line to gain, and hand the ball forward cleanly.

Operational meaning:
- Do not idle because the entire objective cannot be completed in one turn.
- If the primary action is temporarily blocked, advance a safe dependency, test, verification, reconciliation, documentation step, side lane, or handoff that materially moves the SAME goal forward.
- Prefer small proven gains over speculative giant rewrites.
- Every gain must update shared state/relay evidence so the next node begins at the new position rather than rerunning the previous down.
- A blocker should narrow the playbook, not automatically stop the drive.
- Do not manufacture busywork merely to appear active. The yard gained must reduce uncertainty, remove a dependency, prove an invariant, fix a defect, or move execution closer to the done condition.
- Preserve possession: don't break known-green behavior to chase unnecessary scope.

Relationship to RUN THE GAUNTLET:
RUN THE GAUNTLET = execute the full relevant end-to-end obstacle chain.
KEEP THE CHAINS MOVING = while doing so, maintain continuous bounded forward progress through each gate and handoff.

This lexicon entry is durably sharded. Blade, Phoebus, Codex, Antigravity and future lanes should interpret the phrase as an owner execution directive, not decorative language.
